headline: Public hearing on appeal of administrative approval of a fence at 65 Green Acres Drive.
summary: Case ZAP-26-15 lists Soren & Meghan Dews and Katherine Coakley. The appeal concerns ZPF-26-80, an approval for a vinyl privacy fence and a picket fence.
items: Public hearing on ZAP-26-15, an appeal of administrative approval of ZPF-26-80 for a vinyl privacy fence and picket fence at 65 Green Acres Drive (RL, Ward 4)
